/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import subprocess
for n in (500_000, 10_000_000):
    vals = [0.0, 0.0]
    for i in range(n):
        h = (i * 1664525 + 1013904223) & 0xffffffff
        sample = h % 60001 - 30000
        v = (sample / 32768.0) * 0.75 + 0.125
        vals[0] += v
        vals[1] += v * (i % 97 + 1)
    for mode in ([], ['--deny-avx2']):
        p = subprocess.run(['./review-worker', str(n), *mode], check=True, text=True, capture_output=True)
        fields = dict(item.split('=', 1) for item in p.stdout.split())
        got = (float(fields['checksum']), float(fields['weighted']))
        errors = [abs(a-b) for a,b in zip(got, vals)]
        tolerances = [0.01 + 0.00001 * abs(x) for x in vals]
        assert all(e <= t for e,t in zip(errors, tolerances)), (n, mode, errors, tolerances)
        print(f\"n={n} path={fields['selected']} errors={errors} tolerances={tolerances} buffer_bytes={fields['buffer_bytes']}\")
PY"
